hero_lede: One heritage building on Erb Street. Ceremony, cocktails, dinner and dancing in the same place, with catering, open bar, rentals and staff already in the package. You bring the guest list. We handle the rest.
objection_1_q: “Is it big enough for our guest list?”
objection_1_a: The Theatre seats up to 100 for a ceremony and opens into the Lobby Bar for 140 standing. Send your number and the events team will show you the layout that fits.
objection_2_q: “How much do we have to bring in?”
objection_2_a: Almost nothing. Furniture, AV, bar and catering are already in the package, and the building is decorated. Couples arrive with flowers and a cake.
objection_3_q: “Why is there no price on this page?”
objection_3_a: Because everyone's special day is unique, we treat it that way. Once we understand your vision and how we can help, we will make a fully custom proposal just for you.
why_1_body: An 1880 heritage building with original wood, ornate chandeliers, marble and coloured lighting. Couples arrive with flowers and a cake.
why_2_body: Venue, open bar, catering, AV, furniture, staff and parking quoted together. One team, one invoice, one point of contact.
why_3_body: Ceremony, cocktails, dinner and dancing without moving your guests to a second address.
why_4_body: 14 Erb St. West, steps from the LRT, walking distance to hotels and to the restaurants your out-of-town guests will want.
included_intro: Eight things that are already in the quote, so they are not eight more conversations.
incl_1_body: The Theatre, the Lobby Bar and the run of the building for your day.
incl_2_body: A staffed bar in the Lobby, in the package rather than a line item.
incl_3_body: Chef-led menus built with you, cooked in the building's own kitchen.
incl_4_body: Tables, seating and the room's own furniture. Nothing trucked in.
incl_5_body: A 16-foot video wall, wireless microphones and Sonos throughout.
incl_6_body: The events team runs your night, from set-up to clean-up.
incl_7_body: On-site parking, and the LRT stops a short walk away.
incl_8_body: An 1880 building that is already decorated. No draping required.
roomsshort_intro: The Theatre and the Lobby Bar run together as one night. The Library takes the smaller sittings.
room_1_body: The ceremony room. Elevated seating in velvet, a 16-foot video wall, wireless microphones, Sonos and lighting you can set to your colours. Flexible furniture, so the same room turns over for dinner and dancing while your guests are next door.
room_2_meta: Up to 140 with the Theatre, standing
room_2_body: Full bar, ornate chandeliers, original wood, accessible washrooms and direct catering access. Where guests arrive, where cocktails happen during the turnover, and where the night tends to end.
room_3_body: One long-table room with a video screen and custom seating. Right for a micro wedding, a rehearsal dinner or a shower. Available as an add-on to a Theatre rental from $1,000 per hour, or booked on its own.
gallery_heading: The Rooms, And What Happens In Them
timeline_intro: Nobody gets in a car between the vows and the last song.
step_1_name: Guests come up the front steps
step_1_body: Between the two stone lions and through the colonnade. The photos start before anyone is seated.
step_2_body: Elevated seating so everyone actually sees. Wireless mics so everyone hears the vows. Doors close behind your guests.
step_3_body: Full bar, chandeliers, original wood. Your guests never leave the building — and you are outside on the steps having photos taken.
explore_eyebrow: Built for productivity. Balanced for life.
